description: The Perl5 regular expression engine (Apache ORO) for Lucee. Registers the regex engine "perl" (aliases "perl5", "classic", "oro") that was part of the Lucee core until Lucee 8. Select it with this.regex.type="perl" in Application.cfc or the regexType setting of the server.
